source_universe: RAKL_math open PR #190 proposal/shadow B1a4 episode (routing only)

episodes.source_context: local smooth solution on B1×[-1,0) under pointwise Type-I carrier and annular pressure bound

relations: small one-time ∂sU feeds a weighted finite-radius Bernoulli/eigenfunction estimate
weighted estimate yields small local enstrophy
small local enstrophy propagates and feeds CKN epsilon regularity
constraints: one-time generator smallness (1.17) or weighted-L1 variant
failure_mechanisms: Bernoulli maximum-principle/sign structure is not robust under rotated self-similarity
desired_transition: replace a missing scalar sign law with a quantitative weighted-L2 rigidity channel
forbidden_losses: do not replace pointwise Type-I with finite I without proof
do not replace annular L∞ pressure with D
do not infer ∂sU smallness from compactness without a recurrence/speed estimate

episodes.transformation_name: one-slice scaling-generator defect -> weighted-L2 local enstrophy -> epsilon regularity
episodes.operation: localize the weighted Bernoulli-function estimate with a principal eigenfunction, use small ∂sU at one late time to obtain small local enstrophy, propagate it, then apply CKN epsilon regularity
preconditions: smooth local solution on the punctured pre-singularity cylinder
preserved_invariants: no reliance on a global exact self-similar ansatz
known_breakpoints: carrier mismatch between finite I and pointwise Type-I
pressure carrier not upgraded to annular L∞
